summary: Stores the incoming parameter a2 into this[7] (byte offset 0x1C of the __thiscall object), then invokes UISparkleEffect and returns its result. A simple field setter followed by a triggering side-effect call.

operations.description: Store parameter a2 into this[7], the dword at byte offset 0x1C of the __thiscall object.
Invoke UISparkleEffect with no arguments; its return value becomes this function's result.
Return the value produced by UISparkleEffect.
Called by ParamRangeClampedLerp to commit a computed value into this+0x1C before triggering the sparkle effect.

unresolved: Semantic meaning and type of the stored value at this+0x1C (existing analysis asserts a normalized float-as-int consumed by UISparkleEffect) is not re-established from the raw source alone.
